fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. "When the flame went up from the altar to the sky, the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame." (Judges 13:20). The text says the LORD did a marvelous thing, and Manoah and his wife looked on as it happened. When they saw it, they fell facedown to the ground. That's a visit nobody forgets.

No dreams in this verse, friend. The text says, "…the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol." (Judges 13:25). Nothing here is something Samson sees in his sleep. The stirring comes from the Spirit of the LORD, and I think that's a much better wake-up call than any alarm clock.
